36701.meaning1: (of a bird) chirped; tweeted; cooed; called; sang
36701.commentary: (THIa) kokilā'va madhuraṃ nikūji'han'ti… anusaṃgītanivāsinī kokilā viya madhur'ālāpaṃ nikūji'haṃ.

examples.text: kānanamhi vanasaṇḍacārinī, kokilā'va madhuraṃ nikūji'haṃ, taṃ jarāya khalitaṃ tahiṃ tahiṃ, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.
uyyuñjanti satīmanto, na nikete ramanti te, haṃsā'va pallalaṃ hitvā, okam'okaṃ jahanti te.

kathañ'ca, gahapati, niketasārī hoti? rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati.

36709.meaning2: having a home; (one) who has a long connection with

examples.text: yesañ'ca kho etaṃ bhante ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya, nikkaṅkhā te tattha nibbicikicchā
asaṃsayassa kusalassa, venayikassa sārathivarassa, anuttarassa ruciradhammassa, nikkaṅkhassa pabhāsakassa, mānacchidassa vīrassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ kupito anattamano saṅghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍheyya vā nikkaḍḍhāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
nikkaḍḍheyyā'ti gabbhe gahetvā pamukhaṃ nikkaḍḍhati, āpatti pācittiyassa. pamukhe gahetvā bahi nikkaḍḍhati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ekena payogena bahuke'pi dvāre atikkāmeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

36717.meaning1: causes to expel; makes throw out (from)

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ kupito anattamano saṅghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍheyya vā nikkaḍḍhāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.

36720.meaning2: should be thrown or dragged out, should be expelled

examples.text: jivhaṃ baḷisena gahetvā ārajay'ārajayā vihanantī'ti tattha asipattavane vegena dhāvitvā patitānaṃ musāvādīnaṃ nerayikānaṃ nirayapālā jivhaṃ baḷisena nikkaḍḍhitvā yathā manussā allacammaṃ bhūmiyaṃ pattharitvā khilehi ākoṭenti, evaṃ ākoṭetvā pharasūhi phāletvā phāletvā ekam'ekaṃ koṭiṃ chindetvā vihananti, chinnachinnā koṭi punappunaṃ samuṭṭhāti.

36727.meaning1: pared off; stripped clean; hewn off
36727.commentary: (MNa) sunikkantaṃ nikkantan'ti yathā sunikkantaṃ hoti, evaṃ nikkantaṃ nillikhitaṃ, yadettha allīnamaṃsaṃ atthi, taṃ sabbaṃ nillikhitvā aṭṭhimattam'eva katan'ti attho.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ dakkho goghātako vā goghātak'antevāsī vā aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikkantaṃ nikkantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ upasumbheyya.
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ n'uppajjati uppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ pahīyati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ārambhadhātu nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu

36729.commentary: (JAa) saccanikkamo'ti sacce sabhāvabhūte yathāvutte sīladhamme nikkamena samannāgato. (JAa) saccanikkamo tathaparakkamo dhammadevaputto pāyāsi.

examples.text: upāyāsā ca te sabbe, viddhastā vinaḷīkatā, sītibhūto damappatto, dhitimā saccanikkamo.
brāhmaṇo ca kathaṃ jahe, sabbadhammāna pāragū, yo dhammamanupāleti, dhitimā saccanikkamo'ti.

36730.meaning1: strives; exerts oneself; makes an effort; endeavours
36730.synonym: āyūhati, ussahati, ghaṭati, ghaṭeti, padahati, parakkamati, vāyamati
36730.commentary: (SNa) ārambhathā'ti ārambhavīriyaṃ karotha. nikkamathā'ti nikkamavīriyaṃ karotha. yuñjathā'ti payogaṃ karotha parakkamatha.

examples.text: ārambhatha nikkamatha, yuñjatha buddhasāsane, dhunātha maccuno senaṃ, naḷ'āgāraṃ'va kuñjaro.

36731.meaning1: principle of endurance; element of persistence; (comm) stronger effort
36731.commentary: (ANa) nikkamadhātū'ti kosajjato nikkhamanasabhāvaṃ vīriyaṃ. (SNa) nikkamadhātū'ti kosajjato nikkhantattā tato balavataraṃ.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, atthi ārabbhadhātu… atthi nikkamadhātu… atthi parakkamadhātu… atthi thāmadhātu… atthi ṭhitidhātu… atthi upakkamadhātū'ti? evaṃ, bho.
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ n'uppajjati uppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ pahīyati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ārambhadhātu nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu

36733.meaning1: with no opportunity to do; without occasion to perform

examples.text: iti sakaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ katattā, nikkaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ pakatiyā pariniṭṭhitattā, evan'taṃ navavidhaṃ pubbakiccaṃ pariniṭṭhitaṃ hoti.
ye lūkhasā dāruṇā piṭṭhimaṃsikā, mittadduno nikkaruṇā-atimānino, adānasīlā na ca denti kassaci, es'āmagandho na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ.
karuṇaṃ bhāvetu'kāmena pana nikkaruṇatāya ādīnavaṃ karuṇāya ca ānisaṃsaṃ paccavekkhitvā karuṇābhāvanā ārabhitabbā.

36737.meaning1: free from impurity; undefiled; pure; without fault

examples.text: yo brāhmaṇo bāhitapāpadhammo, nihuṃhuṅko nikkasāvo yat'atto, ved'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, dhammena so brahmavādaṃ vadeyya, yass'ussadā n'atthi kuhiñci loke'ti.
ye suppayuttā manasā daḷhena, nikkāmino gotamasāsanamhi, te pattipattā amataṃ vigayha, laddhā mudhā nibbutiṃ bhuñjamānā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

36741.meaning1: without grounds; with no basis; unnecessary

nikkāraṇa + ā

36744.meaning1: without uneasiness; without anxiety; without concern
36744.construction:

36745.commentary: (ADha) nikkujjo'ti adhomukho ṭhapito. evam'evan'ti ettha kumbho nikkujjo viya avakujjapañño puggalo daṭṭhabbo. udakāsiñcanakālo viya dhammadesanāya laddhakālo. udakassa vivaṭṭanakālo viya tasmiṃ āsane nisinnassa uggahetuṃ asamatthakālo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kumbho nikkujjo tatra udakaṃ āsittaṃ vivaṭṭati, no saṇṭhāti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantā hoti abhikkhaṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike dhammassavanāya.
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti.
atha kho bhagavā taṃ udak'ādhānaṃ nikkujjitvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, rāhula, imaṃ udak'ādhānaṃ nikkujjitan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

36747.meaning1: having turned upside down; having inverted

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā taṃ udak'ādhānaṃ nikkujjitvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, rāhula, imaṃ udak'ādhānaṃ nikkujjitan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

36749.commentary: (ANa) nikkujjeyyā'ti tena dinnassa deyyadhammassa appaṭiggahaṇ'atthaṃ pattanikkujjanakammavācāya nikujjeyya, na adhomukhaṭhapanena.

examples.text: apissu naṃ, mārisa, amanussā attāhi'pi paripuṇṇāhi paribhāsāhi paribhāseyyuṃ. apissu naṃ, mārisa, amanussā rittaṃ'pi'ssa pattaṃ sīse nikkujjeyyuṃ. apissu naṃ, mārisa, amanussā sattadhā'pi'ssa muddhaṃ phāleyyuṃ.
imehi kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhah'aṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pattaṃ nikkujjeyya.

36752.meaning1: not deceitful; not deceptive; not fake

examples.text: ye ca kho te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā atthaddhā susamāhitā, te kho me, bhikkhave, bhikkhū māmakā. anapagatā ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā. te ca imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjantī'ti.
nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā, atthaddhā susamāhitā, te ve dhamme virūhanti, sammāsambuddhadesite'ti.

36754.meaning1: golden ornament; heavy piece of golden jewellery

examples.text: nikkhaṃ jambonadass'eva, ko taṃ ninditum'arahati, devā'pi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunā'pi pasaṃsito.
seyyathā'pi nāma nikkhaṃ jambonadaṃ dakkha-kammāraputta-ukkāmukha-sukusala-sampahaṭṭhaṃ paṇḍukambale nikkhittaṃ bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca

36757.meaning1: mass of gold; hoard of gold coins

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, nekānaṃ nikkhagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ dhaññagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ khettagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ vatthugaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ bhariyagaṇānaṃ cayo
atha kho so bhikkhu vihāraṃ pavisissāmī'ti kavāṭaṃ paṇāmento addasa sabbaṃ vihāraṃ ahinā puṇṇaṃ, vātapānehi bhoge nikkhante, disvāna bhīto vissaram'akāsi.
atha kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante paṭhame yāme, uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
idha bhikkhu divase nikkhante rattiyā patihitāya iti paṭisañcikkhati, bahukā kho me paccayā maraṇassa
manussānaṃ vārentānaṃ vārentānam'eva saṭṭhisahassā balavagāvo ca saṭṭhisahassā dhenuyo ca nikkhantā

36766.grammar: idiom, pp + ordin + masc, loc abs
36766.meaning1: when the first part of the night was over

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante paṭhame yāme, uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nigrodhakappo pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisati, sāyaṃ vā nikkhamati aparajju vā kāle
yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ… yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ adhobhāgaṃ nikkhamati… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu.
ārabbhatha nikkhamatha, yuñjatha buddhasāsane, dhunātha maccuno senaṃ, naḷ'āgāraṃ'va kuñjaro.
so tassa nagarassa samantā anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamati. anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā, antamaso biḷāranikkhamanamattam'pi.
tasmiṃ pana nagare anusaṃvaccharaṃ vivaṭanakkhattaṃ nāma hoti. tadā bahi anikkhamanakulāni'pi parivārena saddhiṃ gehā nikkhamitvā appaṭicchannena sarīrena padasā'va nadītīraṃ gacchanti

36772.meaning1: time when exiting; time of going out

examples.text: sattamaṃ sutvā, yasmiṃ vammike so sappo vasati, tassa heṭṭhā mahantī nidhikumbhi atthi, so taṃ rakkhamāno vasanto nikkhamanakāle dhanalobhena sarīraṃ sithilaṃ katvā lagganto nikkhamati, gocaraṃ gahetvā dhanasinehena alagganto vegena sahasā pavisati. taṃ nidhikumbhiṃ uddharitvā tvaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti āha.

36774.meaning1: space to get out; room to leave

examples.text: sā… sappassa nikkhaman'okāsaṃ katvā, abbhumme anto sappo'ti vīṇaṃ chaḍḍetvā palāyi
tattha cakkhumā puriso majjhe ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisante'pi nikkhamante'pi
dvattipattapūre paṭiggahetvā tato nikkhamantena bhikkhuṃ passitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ, amutra mayā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahitā, mā kho tattha paṭiggaṇhī'ti.

36779.commentary: (DNa) so pāto'y'eva uposath'aṅgāni adhiṭṭhāya pubb'aṇhasamaye buddhappamukhassa saṅghassa dānaṃ datvā bhikkhūsu vihāraṃ gatesu ghare khuddakamahallakānaṃ dārakānaṃ saddena ubbāḷho satthu santike dhammaṃ sossāmī'ti nikkhanto. tena vuttaṃ divā divassa rājagahā nikkhamī'ti.

examples.text: atha kho pañcak'aṅgo thapati sāvatthiyā nikkhami divā divassa bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
ṭhitako'va mātukucchisambhavena kenaci asucinā amakkhito suddho visado kāsikavatthe nikkhittamaṇiratanaṃ viya jotayanto mātukucchito nikkhami.

36780.meaning1: renounced; ordained; left the household life

examples.text: n'āhaṃ alakkhyā ahirikkatāya vā, na cittahetū na ca dūrakantanā, ājīvahetū ca ahaṃ na nikkhamiṃ, kato ca te citta paṭissavo mayā.

36781.meaning1: should be left; should be departed (from)
36781.meaning2: should be gone out, should be gone forth from, should be left the household life

36783.meaning2: to go forth from, to leave the household life

36784.meaning1: having gone out (from); having exited; having left
36784.meaning2: having gone out, having gone forth from

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ nagaramhā nikkhamitvā addasa bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ kālaṅ'kataṃ.

atha kho, āvuso, rājā pasenadi kosalo sāvatthiyā nikkhamitvā antepuradvārā paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya, paṭhamena rathavinītena dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya, paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya.
annaṃ pānañ'ca ādāya, khajjaṃ bhojjaṃ anappakaṃ, gehato nikkhamitvāna, uyyānam'abhihārayiṃ.
divāvihārā nikkhamma, gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate, addasaṃ virajaṃ buddhaṃ, bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ.
divāvihārā nikkhamma, gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate, nāgaṃ ogāham'uttiṇṇaṃ, nadītīramhi addasaṃ.

36788.meaning1: going forth; leaving the household life; ordaining
36788.meaning2: going forth from, leaving the household life
36788.commentary: (THIa) evaṃ saddhāya nikkhammā'ti hitvān'ahaṃ ñātigaṇan'ti-ādinā vuttappakārena mahantaṃ ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ mahantañ'ca bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya kammakammaphalāni ratanattayañ'cā'ti saddheyyavatthuṃ saddhāya saddahitvā gharato nikkhamma

examples.text: pahāy'ahaṃ pabbajitā, sāpateyyam'anappakaṃ, evaṃ saddhāya nikkhamma, saddhamme suppavedite.

36789.meaning1: driven out; forced to leave; removed; ejected (from)

examples.text: nikkhāmito, bhante, so puggalo mayā. parisuddhā parisā

36790.meaning1: drives out; expels; ejects; kicks out (somebody from)
36790.meaning2: causes to make to go out, causes to bring forth or out
36790.commentary: (SNa) dārehi saṃpuccha gharā nikkhāmentī'ti sabbaṃ mama santakaṃ gahetvā mayhaṃ niddhanabhāvaṃ ñatvā attano bhariyāhi saddhiṃ mantayitvā maṃ gharā nikkaḍḍhāpenti.

examples.text: idha me, bho gotama, cattāro puttā. te maṃ dārehi saṃpuccha gharā nikkhāmentī'ti. tena hi tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imā gāthāyo pariyāpuṇitvā sabhāyaṃ mahājanakāye sannipatite puttesu ca sannisinnesu bhāsassu

36791.meaning2: having caused to make to go out, having caused to bring forth or out

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahidvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindathā'ti.

36792.meaning2: causing to make to go out, causing to bring forth or out

examples.text: addasā kho bhagavā sen'āsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto te bhikkhū taṃ bhikkhuṃ pariggahetvā uccāram'pi passāvam'pi nikkhāmente, disvāna yena te bhikkhū ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca, kiṃ imassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ābādho'ti?

36793.meaning2: caused to make to go out, caused to bring forth or out

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī cātumahāpathe nikkhittā assa. atha cha purisā āgaccheyyuṃ byābhaṅgihatthā. te yavakalāpiṃ chahi byābhaṅgīhi haneyyuṃ. evañ'hi sā, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī suhatā assa chahi byābhaṅgīhi haññamānā.
nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto āvilo luḷito kalalībhūto andhakāre nikkhitto. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya.
seyyathā'pi nāma maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
so aparena samayena chātakabhaye sampatte yathānikkhittaṃ dhaññaṃ paribhuñjanto koṭṭhesu ca cāṭiādīsu ca nikkhittadhaññe parikkhīṇe parijane pakkosāpetvā āha.
aparikkhittaṃ hoti, yasmiṃ gabbhe cīvaraṃ nikkhittaṃ hoti tasmiṃ gabbhe vatthabbaṃ, hatthapāsā vā na vijahitabbaṃ.

36797.meaning2: (of a sutta) spoken (about); given (in reference to)

examples.text: na tassa pacchā na purattham'atthi, santo vidhūmo anigho nirāso, nikkhittadaṇḍo tasathāvaresu, so ty'āhutiṃ bhuñjatu aggapiṇḍaṃ.

36799.meaning1: abandoned duty (towards); shirking responsibility (towards); not taking responsibility (for)

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā… sāmaññe anapekkhavanto sikkhāya na tibbagāravā bāhulikā sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅ'gamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā… na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

idh'āvuso satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekaṃ n'ānusikkhanti, yesañ'ca dhammānaṃ satthā pahānam'āha, te ca dhamme nappajahanti, bāhulikā ca honti, sāthalikā, okkamane pubbaṅ'gamā, paviveke nikkhittadhurā
